common_name: Big Bang Chinese Ground Orchid (Large-Flowered Vigorous Bletilla)

planting.note: Plant dormant pseudobulbs 2-3 inches deep in spring after last frost; Big Bang is a vigorous Bletilla selection with unusually large magenta-pink flowers and a heavier bloom count than the species.

directions: Plant pseudobulbs 2-3 inches deep in rich, well-drained, humus-rich soil in part shade to full shade. Big Bang bears notably large, showy magenta-pink flowers on upright spikes in April to May before the pleated, strap-like foliage reaches full height, with a heavier flower count per spike and bigger individual blooms than the standard species, making a bolder statement in a shaded border. Clumps expand slowly over years; never dig out the entire clump, instead taking divisions from the perimeter while leaving the main clump undisturbed. Provide a light mulch in the coldest parts of its range, and avoid waterlogged soils, which cause pseudobulb rot.
